class.name: GroundData
class.brief_description: A static ground as data (a height field and box and cylinder props) for casting rays straight down without the physics engine.
class.description: Holds what a training terrain's static ground is made of, so a [RigKernel]'s ground probes and height scan can read it instead of casting rays in the physics engine. The rays are Jolt's: straight down for a length, the first surface met; a shape the ray starts inside is not hit; the height field's cells are split as Godot's Jolt module splits them. The caller must build the same shapes into the physics.

method.name: add_box
method.description: Adds a box prop with the given transform and half extents.

method.name: add_cylinder
method.description: Adds a cylinder prop (its axis the transform's Y) with the given radius and height.

method.name: cast_down
method.description: Returns the height of the first surface straight down from [param from] within [param length], or NaN when there is none.

method.name: cast_down_batch
method.description: [method cast_down] for each point.

method.name: clear_props
method.description: Removes every prop.

method.name: clear_water
method.description: Removes the water field.

method.name: friction_at
method.description: Returns the friction of the height field's cell under [param point]'s x and z ([method set_field_frictions]), or NaN off the field or with none set.

method.name: friction_at_batch
method.description: Returns [method friction_at] for each of [param points].

method.name: get_prop_count
method.description: Returns the number of props.

method.name: has_water_field
method.description: Returns whether a water field is set.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns whether a [RigKernel] reads this data.

method.name: nearest_trunks
method.description: Returns the [param count] nearest trunks (upright cylinders at least 1 m tall) within [param range] of [param xform]'s origin, nearest first, in its frame: x, z, radius and 1 for each, zeros past the last one found.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Sets whether a [RigKernel] reads this data (off while the terrain is off the physics world).

method.name: set_field_frictions
method.description: Sets the height field's friction per cell, as the physics' ([code]JoltPhysicsServer3D.height_map_shape_set_cell_frictions[/code]): each of the [code](width - 1) * (depth - 1)[/code] cells' index (row-major, as the heights) into [param frictions]. Empty [param cells] clears them.

method.name: set_height_field
method.description: Sets the height field: a [HeightMapShape3D]'s width, depth and heights, and its collision shape's global transform (a scale and a translation).

method.name: set_height_field_transform
method.description: Sets the height field's transform alone (its scale changed).

method.name: set_water_field
method.description: Sets a water field: the surface's height (NaN where dry) and its flow (x, z) at a [param width] by [param depth] grid of samples, placed as a height field's are by [param xform] (a scale and a translation; its Y scale multiplies the heights). The field is to reach past the shore by a cell's diagonal or more: a cell with a dry corner is dry. Read by [WaterForces] and by a [RigKernel]'s water inputs ([method RigKernel.set_water]).

method.name: set_water_transform
method.description: Places the water field by [param xform] and scales its flow by [param flow_scale].

method.name: water_at
method.description: Returns the water at [param point]'s x and z: the surface's height (NaN where dry) and the flow's x and z, bilinear over the field's cell.

method.name: water_top_near
method.description: Returns the highest surface over the field's samples within [param radius] of [param point] in x and z, or -INF.
